# Siddhi's Coaching Classes

> Trusted coaching and tuition institute in Chembur, Mumbai since 2003, offering SSC, HSC (Science & Commerce), and entrance-exam coaching (MH-CET, NEET, JEE Main) plus CA Foundation. Small batches, qualified faculty (PhDs, MBBS doctors, Chartered Accountants, IIT graduates), and a proven record of board and entrance results.

## Key facts

- Name: Siddhi's Coaching Classes
- Founded: 2003
- Location: Chembur, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400071, India
- Phone: +91 9594345743, +91 7208476547
- Timings: Monday–Saturday, 6:30 AM – 9:00 PM (Morning, Afternoon, and Evening batches)

## Centres

- Centre 1 — Shell Colony (Sahakar Nagar): Shop No. 5, 6 & 7, Veena Serene Building, B-Wing, Sahakar Nagar Road No. 4, Chembur, Mumbai 400071
- Centre 2 — Shell Colony (Adarsha Vidyalaya): E-30/A, Guru Krupa, Nanda Deep Everest Society, Shell Colony Road, near Adarsha Vidyalaya, Chembur, Mumbai 400071

## Courses

- SSC Board (Classes 8–10): Maharashtra State Board foundation coaching
- HSC Science (Classes 11–12): Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology with MH-CET / NEET / JEE Main preparation
- HSC Commerce (Classes 11–12): Accounts, Economics, Business Studies, OCM, Maths & Statistics
- MH-CET / NEET / JEE Main: Dedicated entrance-exam batches
- CA Foundation: Post-Class-12 Chartered Accountancy foundation coaching
